question: A man covers half part of a certain distance at 60 km/hr. He covers 40 percent of remaining distance at the speed of 12 km/hr and covers rest of the distance at the speed of 18 km/hr. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation:**

Let, the total distance = 100a

Time taken to cover half of the distance = (50a / 60) = 5a/6 hour

Time taken to cover 40% of the half distance = (40% × 50a) / 12 = 5a/3 hour

Time taken to cover remaining distance = 30a / 18 = 5a / 3 hour

Total time taken = (5a/6 + 5a/3 + 5a/3) = (25a / 6) hour

⇒ Average Speed = 100a / (25a/6) 

⇒ 4 × 6 = 24 km/hr

**∴ The Average speed is 24 km/hr.**
